reviewMethod: Read-only source, original review, poster and supplied diagnostic Blender-render inspection. No browser, independent runtime execution or video playback. Only final-review.json files written. Integrated UI verification belongs to coordinator.
gateStandard: Require useful spatial inspection beyond the existing video, not impossibility of representing the lesson in 2D.
spatialBenefitAssessment: The bridge passes the conceptual spatial gate: inspecting under the deck exposes evidence, while inspecting the prop against the hull and the underpin against the channel exposes a competing physical requirement. Depth serves diagnosis and clearance comparison rather than decorating a route graph. Four selectable handoffs add counterfactual inspection beyond the fixed invoice video.
rationale: The redesign addresses the original blockers: explicit four-state keyboard cycle, synchronized toggles, stale repair removal, a test camera, stronger repair geometry and appropriately limited authored-example captions. Diagnostic prop, patch and underpin renders distinguish the outcomes. Acceptance is of spatial design and source, with integrated visibility and interaction checks still outstanding.

findings.issue: Picking evidence after a completed test changes the handoff and immediately removes the repair being inspected.
findings.evidence: setState calls restoreBridge when tested; boat/buoy and upstream pier picks toggle rather than merely describe. The interaction hint and changed caption disclose this behavior.
findings.requestedChange: Coordinator should verify this remains understandable during result inspection; it is not a conceptual blocker because orbiting and repair picks preserve the result.

findings.issue: The lane envelope dominates the successful-repair render, and the prop contact is close to the pier silhouette.
findings.evidence: captures/blender-ctx-underpin.png and blender-ctx-prop.png show improved geometry but do not establish 420px WebGL readability.
findings.requestedChange: Verify hull/prop contact, banded underpin footprint and fascia crack at 420px and desktop, including an orbit with captions hidden.

findings.issue: Repair selection remains deterministic and is an analogy, not evidence that richer context guarantees success.
findings.evidence: chooseRepair maps handoffs directly to patch/prop/underpin; captions now explicitly call these examples and limit passing checks.
findings.requestedChange: Retain those limitations and the distinction between inspecting an object and supplying it in the handoff.

requiredVerification: Coordinator: keyboard-cycle all four handoffs; verify switching after a check clears repair and results, and Reset/reduced motion/idle-on-load work.
Coordinator: confirm nearest-visible picking, no hidden split selection through solids, and water/clearance do not intercept picks.
Coordinator: inspect all three repair outcomes at desktop and 420px; diagnostic Blender images are not integrated browser evidence.
